startup.top_n_products:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    10,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'Product'[Product],
        'Product'[Category],
        "SalesAmount", SUM('Sales'[Sales Amount]),
        "Profit", SUM('Sales'[Sales Amount]) - SUM('Sales'[Total Product Cost])
    ),
    [SalesAmount],
    DESC
)
startup.kpi_totals:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Revenue", SUM('Sales'[Sales Amount]),
    "Profit", SUM('Sales'[Sales Amount]) - SUM('Sales'[Total Product Cost]),
    "Orders", DISTINCTCOUNT('Sales Order'[Sales Order]),
    "AvgOrderValue", DIVIDE(SUM('Sales'[Sales Amount]), DISTINCTCOUNT('Sales Order'[Sales Order]))
)
startup.model_schema:
EVALUATE
UNION(
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(
            INFO.VIEW.COLUMNS(),
            [Type] <> "RowNumber" &&
            [DataCategory] <> "RowNumber" &&
            [IsHidden] = FALSE() &&
            NOT(CONTAINSSTRING([Name], "RowNumber"))
        ),
        "Table", [Table],
        "Name", [Name],
        "Type", "Column"
    ),
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(
            INFO.VIEW.MEASURES(),
            [IsHidden] = FALSE()
        ),
        "Table", [Table],
        "Name", [Name],
        "Type", "Measure"
    )
)
